notes.title: New Year's update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35063584/6cce06f7a26209a90b94e23f3b7bc9f1f9535eff.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Dear comrades![/b] Our team wishes you a [u][b]Happy New Year![/b][/u] 
In honor of this event we have released a [u]new update[/u]. We fixed many bugs and [u]added a new holiday design[/u]. Next year will see the [u]release of our other project[/u], as well as a [u]major update[/u] of [b]Sex with Stalin![/b] We are glad that you stay with us! [/h3]

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35063584/ee1a659bf0917d6c00ca79d4fb830245097bd5c6.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hey, friends![/b]

We are [b]happy to announce[/b] that we already [b]fixed more than 15 reported bugs[/b] and issues since the release! And we also added the much-requested [b][u]ability to skip the text from the very beginning of the game[/u][/b]. If you would like to help us [b]with the further development, we would appreciate more honest and thorough reviews.[/b]

[b]Thank you for your continued support![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Release tomorrow!
notes.notes:
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35063584/18cb6e04193ae41a30b166f6d5b656918a6cdf84.jpg[/img]
[b]Dear comrades[/b], it is with great pleasure we announce that the release of the [b]Sex with Stalin[/b] happens tomorrow, [b]10 AM PST[/b]. 

[h2][b]P.S.[/b][/h2]

Our [i]enemies[/i] tried to [b]sabotage[/b] the [b]developmen[/b]t and prevent the game from ever seeing the light of day, but they failed! Let your friends know, [b]add the game to the wishlist[/b], and wait for the announcement![/h3]

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35063584/da2fe3e7502e88721405484da34f91bca43b9b2f.jpg[/img]
Greetings everyone! I apologize for such a long silence. Unfortunately I had to move release date to 2020 (february-may), because of the threats from communists. Many members of my team got scared and left the project, so I had to look for new specialists, and do a lot of their work by myself. As of now, development is going full force, all problems were regulated.

Your support is very important! If you like the project, then tell your friends about it! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35063584/2e116a913d83df5f8fa5ebd6230ff9f5d9995e32.jpg[/img]
